import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create the figure and axes
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a bar plot showing survival rate by sex and passenger class
# Use hue to differentiate by passenger class
sns.barplot(data=df, x='sex', y='survived', hue='pclass', palette='viridis', errorbar=None)

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Survival Rate on the Titanic by Sex and Passenger Class', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sex', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)

# Customize x-axis tick labels for better readability
plt.xticks(ticks=[0, 1], labels=['Female', 'Male'], fontsize=10)

# Customize y-axis to show percentage-like values
plt.yticks(fontsize=10)
plt.ylim(0, 1) # Survival rate is between 0 and 1

# Add a legend for passenger class
plt.legend(title='Passenger Class', loc='upper right', labels=['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'])

# Add grid for better readability
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
